channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lulinha processa Zema por vídeo feito com IA
item.description: Businessman Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) filed a lawsuit in São Paulo against presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema (Novo party), demanding removal of an AI-generated video depicting him in a marijuana plantation. The action was reported by newspaper O Fator.

item.title: Os 18 acessos de Lulinha ao Palácio do Planalto
item.description: Businessman Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, President Lula's son, recorded 18 entries to the Presidential Palace between June 2023 and January 2025, according to data obtained by O Globo via FOIA.

item.title: Brasil pede "diálogo" na OEA para lidar com situação na Nicarágua
item.description: Brazil advocated for dialogue and a technical approach at the OAS regarding Nicaragua's crisis, being the sole country to vote against an emergency foreign ministers' meeting. Ambassador Benoni Belli argued diplomatic channels in the Permanent Council weren't exhausted, while 29 nations approved the meeting to discuss potential constitutional changes blocking opposition participation in Nicaraguan elections.

item.title: Flávio posta vídeo de sunga e faixa presidencial com estética de GTA 6
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) shared an AI-generated video showing him in swimwear and presidential sash with GTA 6 aesthetics. The post on X went viral for days while his campaign declined to comment on its intent, despite coinciding with peak interest in the game's release.

item.title: ACM Neto nega incentivar voto casado com Lula e reafirma apoio a Caiado
item.description: Bahia gubernatorial candidate ACM Neto (União Brasil) denied encouraging a 'split ticket' vote with President Lula (PT) and reaffirmed his support for Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) for the presidency, stating he will respect his voters' other choices.

item.title: Renan Santos derruba barricada do CV em João Pessoa
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party presidential candidate, helped dismantle a barricade linked to the Red Command in João Pessoa, Paraíba, on Wednesday (19). He used the operation to showcase his pledge to fight territorial control by criminal gangs. The move highlights public security as a key theme of his 2026 election campaign.

item.title: Cláudio Castro ‘não vai subir no meu palanque’, diz Douglas Ruas a VEJA
item.description: PL candidate for Rio governor Douglas Ruas said former governor Cláudio Castro will not join his campaign and advocated a shift in public security policy, focusing on retaking territories from criminal factions and integration with federal forces. He also addressed investigations into the state pension fund and his tenure as Cities Secretary.

item.title: Debaixo do colchão: veja quem são os candidatos que declaram ter milhões em dinheiro vivo
item.description: Eight candidates declared nearly R$ 79 million in cash at the TSE. The largest amount belongs to Luiz Teodoro dos Santos (R$ 30 million), followed by Clebio Lopes Jacaré (R$ 11.95 million), who was arrested in 2022 for corruption. Half of the candidates are from the Northeast.

item.title: TRE-SP mantém multa a Lula por pedir voto a Tebet e Marina Silva
item.description: The São Paulo Regional Electoral Court upheld a R$15,000 fine against Lula for early campaign advertising. The president, running for re-election, requested votes for Simone Tebet and Marina Silva for Senate during an official event in May.

item.title: Lula recebe R$ 500 nas primeiras doações
item.description: Lula (PT) and Wilson Grassi (Democrata) are the first presidential candidates to report donations to the Electoral Justice. Lula received R$500, while Grassi donated R$290,000 to his own campaign.

item.title: Como o PT deve explorar o silêncio de Flávio Bolsonaro, que segue sem prestar contas sobre Vorcaro
item.description: The Workers' Party plans to exploit Flávio Bolsonaro's silence over the 'Dark Horse' film financing with Banco Master funds from Daniel Vorcaro. After 90 days since his promise for detailed accounting, the PL presidential candidate has not released a public report. The PT strategy aims to counterattack investigations involving Lula's son and allies, keeping the case prominent in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Quem Ciro apoiará na eleição presidencial?
item.description: Ciro Gomes (PSDB), running for governor of Ceará, stated he has not yet decided whom to support in the 2026 presidential election, but ruled out backing Lula (PT) or Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). He mentioned he is discussing the matter with Aécio Neves.

item.title: Lula defende submarino nuclear e diz que Brasil não pode ficar 'de cabeça baixa a vida inteira'
item.description: Lula defends the completion of the Navy's nuclear submarine as a matter of national sovereignty, stating Brazil cannot remain submissive.

item.title: Marqueteiro de Flávio admite repulsa de mulheres a 'jeito' de Bolsonaro: 'É um desafio de comunicação'
item.description: Strategist Duda Lima admits Jair Bolsonaro's "hard" style causes repulsion among women voters, a communication challenge for Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign. Women comprise 52.8% of the electorate, prompting greater involvement of Michelle Bolsonaro. Lima also acknowledges Lula's superior ability to emotionally connect with voters.

item.title: A próxima pesquisa Quaest sobre a disputa entre Haddad e Tarcísio em São Paulo
item.description: Quaest will release a new São Paulo gubernatorial poll on Tuesday (25), based on 1,800 interviews with a 2-point margin of error. A prior Paraná Pesquisas survey shows Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) leading with 50% in the first round versus 33.8% for Fernando Haddad (PT), and 53% to 36.9% in a runoff projection.

item.title: Michelle mobiliza aliados no meio evangélico para ajudar campanha de Flávio após desgaste no segmento
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro mobilizes her network of evangelical leaders to support Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign after initial friction. The former first lady uses her contacts in major denominations and personal appearances to reconnect her stepson with the evangelical base, which was shaken by public disputes and revelations about film financing.

item.title: Brasil tem entrada de US$ 851 milhões na semana até 14 de agosto
item.description: Brazil recorded a positive foreign exchange flow of US$851 million in the week through Aug 14, driven by a US$3.5 billion commercial surplus and a US$2.6 billion financial outflow. Year-to-date flow stands at US$21.2 billion positive. Meanwhile, foreign investors pulled R$15.6 billion from the B3 stock exchange in August, the largest outflow since Jan 2022, amid fiscal and electoral concerns.

item.title: Lula fala em “força” para defender interesses do Brasil
item.description: Lula advocates for national sovereignty and leverage in negotiations during visit to Aramar nuclear center, highlighting the nuclear submarine program that will make Brazil the 7th country with such technology. The president makes indirect reference to tensions with Trump ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula quer evento com 5.000 mulheres em Belo Horizonte
item.description: Lula's re-election campaign organizes the 'National Women with Lula Meeting' on August 29 in Belo Horizonte, expecting 5,000 participants. The event will address combating femicide, equal pay, women's health, digital violence, and female political participation, organized by First Lady Janja and the PT's National Women's Secretariat.

item.title: Disputa sobre inelegibilidade de Dallagnol volta à justiça paranaense às vésperas da eleição
item.description: The Paraná para Todos coalition filed a new request to impugnate Deltan Dallagnol's Senate candidacy, arguing he is ineligible following TSE and STF rulings. The filing seeks definitive denial of his registration, an expedited judgment without evidence, and liability for abuse of the right to run. It claims Dallagnol's move creates legal insecurity and aims to confuse voters.

item.title: TSE já recebeu 1.103 relatos de irregularidades em campanhas
item.description: As of August 19, 2026, Brazil's Superior Electoral Court received 1,103 reports of electoral campaign irregularities, with content boosting being the most common violation (339 cases). São Paulo recorded the highest number of complaints among states, followed by Pernambuco and Paraná. About 54% of the reports remain under review.

item.title: STF adia julgamento sobre eleições para o governo do RJ
item.description: The STF postponed the judgment on the Rio de Janeiro government succession, keeping Justice Ricardo Couto as interim governor. The score was 4-1 favoring an indirect election by the Legislative Assembly, but ministers prioritized another case. Zanin saw a maneuver by Castro resigning before the TSE ruling; Fux questioned the PSD's standing to file the complaint.

item.title: STF adia julgamento sobre mandato-tampão para governador do Rio
item.description: The STF postponed the judgment on whether to hold direct elections for the interim governorship of Rio de Janeiro, prioritizing a ruling on the Maria da Penha Law. The current score is 4 to 1 in favor of indirect election by the Legislative Assembly.

item.title: Na Bahia, ACM Neto nega ligação com Overclean e promete controladoria estadual independente
item.description: ACM Neto (União Brasil) denied involvement in Operation Overclean and pledged, if elected governor of Bahia, to grant autonomy to the state comptroller's office, staffed by technical experts and free from political interference.

item.title: Crusoé: Os possíveis crimes de Lulinha
item.description: President Lula's son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), is under investigation in three Federal Police inquiries and may face charges including influence peddling under Article 332 of the Penal Code.

item.title: O dia em que Bolsonaro disse a Flávio: “você não entende nada de política”
item.description: During the 2022 first-round vote count, Jair Bolsonaro reportedly told his son Flávio: "you don't understand politics," revealing tension between them at the Defense Ministry.

item.title: STF adia julgamento sobre eleição para mandato-tampão no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: The STF postponed the judgment that would define the election model for the interim government in Rio de Janeiro, keeping Judge Ricardo Couto as interim governor. The court currently has a 4-1 score in favor of an indirect election by the state legislative assembly, but the analysis may be delayed until after the October elections.

item.title: Candidato ao Senado no Piauí é intimado a trocar foto de registro em que aparece como Jesus Cristo
item.description: Senate alternate candidate Dilcon Afonso Santos Carvalho (DC) in Piauí was ordered by the Regional Electoral Court to replace his candidacy registration photo depicting him as Jesus Christ. The court gave a three-day deadline to submit a photo complying with Superior Electoral Court rules: recent, color, uniform background, frontal framing, and appropriate attire, under penalty of registration rejection. Carvalho criticized the ruling on social media, claiming selectivity and defending cultural diversity.

item.title: Ibama testa de novo a paciência de Lula na Foz do Amazonas
item.description: Lula again showed frustration with Ibama's delay in authorizing three new Petrobras wells in Foz do Amazonas. During his visit to Amapá, the president celebrated the oil discovery, but licensing did not progress. The agency, headed by Jair Schmitt, has not yet approved the drillings despite the state-owned company meeting technical requirements.

item.title: Toffoli é sorteado para analisar pedido contra decisões de Dino no MA
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli was assigned as rapporteur for Governor Carlos Brandão's request to suspend Flávio Dino's decisions in an embezzlement investigation in Maranhão. The defense claims jurisdictional usurpation of the STJ and violation of the natural judge guarantee, noting Brandão lacked access to case files. Dino removed the governor's nephew from the TCE-MA and argues STF competence is preserved by lottery assignment, citing involvement of politicians with privileged forum.

item.title: Inelegível, Pablo Marçal apela à ‘Band’ por convite para debate presidencial
item.description: Ineligible candidate Pablo Marçal appeals to TV Band for inclusion in Sunday's presidential debate. The broadcaster is not required to invite him but often applies flexible criteria. Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro indicate they will not attend.

item.title: Análise: Em sabatina, Haddad rasga fantasia de candidato ao governo e admite que seu papel é garantir eleição de Lula
item.description: In a sabatina, Fernando Haddad acknowledged his main goal is securing a palanque for Lula in São Paulo rather than winning the state government. With 58% rejection and a campaign seen as improvised, he admitted only recently studying the state, while Tarcísio de Freitas leads with 37% voter intention.

item.title: Governo Lula cria comitê para monitorar ações a trabalhadores de app
item.description: The Lula administration established an interministerial committee to monitor policies for app-based workers such as delivery drivers and ride-hailing drivers. Coordinated by the Labor Ministry and the Presidency's Secretariat-General, the body will assess basic rights, fair pay, and produce sector diagnostics. The move follows recent credit lines as a political outreach to this workforce.

item.title: Sabatina GLOBO/ CBN/ Valor: Veja como foi a entrevista com Haddad em cinco pontos
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) defended continued investigations into Lulinha without interference, called Flávio Bolsonaro a serious institutional risk, and pledged to review privatization contracts without committing to re-statizing Sabesp. The candidate stated the PT cannot shield itself from improper advantages, cited the Banco Master case and four Bolsonaro ministers receiving money, and affirmed the Federal Police and Federal Prosecutor's Office act with full freedom.

item.title: Entidades de imprensa reagem a declarações de Dino e Moraes sobre diploma para jornalistas
item.description: Press entities reacted to statements by STF ministers Flávio Dino and Alexandre de Moraes regarding a possible review of the mandatory journalism diploma requirement, which was struck down by the Supreme Court in 2009.

item.title: Candidato a deputado em SP é condenado após expor eleitora no TikTok
item.description: State deputy candidate Douglas Garcia (União Brasil) was ordered to pay R$20,000 in damages to a voter after exposing her on TikTok and Instagram without consent, having paid her R$50 to change her vote from Lula to Bolsonaro. The video garnered nearly 3 million views and triggered offensive comments. The court ordered its removal under daily fine penalty.

item.title: Equipe de Flávio Bolsonaro modula discurso contra reforma tributária e avalia abreviar transição
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's team is considering shortening the tax reform transition period to cut subsidies and tax benefits, and reviewing sectors with tax relief. The plan criticizes the projected 30% VAT rate, above the OECD average.

item.title: Caiado sobre Marcola, alvo da PF: "Crime da sala do presidente"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado harshly criticizes Lula's former chief of staff Marco Aurélio (Marcola), under PF investigation for receiving jewelry and a loan from a lobbyist. Caiado claims the case reveals corruption at the highest government levels and suggests it should lead to the president's removal. He also criticizes Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro's absence from a Band debate.

item.title: Reprovação de conta não significa inelegibilidade automática, diz presidente do TSE
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques stated that the rejection of accounts of a candidate who held public office does not automatically make that candidate ineligible. The statement was made on August 19, 2026.

item.title: Marqueteiro de Flávio admite desafio com eleitorado feminino
item.description: Campaign marketer Duda Lima admits Jair Bolsonaro's communication style hinders appeal to female voters, who make up 52.8% of the electorate. Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign plans to deploy his wife Fernanda Bolsonaro and Daniella Marques on women-focused agendas addressing security and income, after selecting Alfredo Gaspar as running mate. Duda predicts a tight race and praises Lula's emotional connection with voters.

item.title: Quem é Pablo Marçal, candidato a presidente que deve ser barrado pela Lei da Ficha Limpa
item.description: Pablo Marçal (PRTB) launched a presidential bid despite being ineligible until 2032 following a TRE-SP conviction for improper media use in the 2024 São Paulo mayoral race. The Clean Record Law bars his candidacy without requiring a final appeal ruling, and appeals to the TSE have not yet suspended the conviction. His party registered the candidacy, but the Electoral Court must still rule on the ineligibility.

item.title: Crusoé: Marçal não afeta Lula nas redes
item.description: Pablo Marçal's candidacy announcement had little effect on mentions of Lula on social media, but drove high engagement around right-wing figures like Flávio Bolsonaro. A Datrix survey shows the most shared posts focus on Marçal and other conservative pre-candidates.

item.title: TSE registra 1,1 mil denúncias eleitorais em quatro dias
item.description: The TSE recorded 1,103 electoral complaints in four days of campaigning through the Pardal tool. Complaints refer to violations and irregularities in electoral propaganda since the campaign began on Sunday, the 16th.

item.title: Lula defende mais investimentos em defesa e que Brasil ‘possa enriquecer urânio para fins pacíficos’
item.description: Lula advocates for increased defense investment and national sovereignty, including uranium enrichment for peaceful purposes and completing the submarine program. He criticizes the discontinuity of military investments by previous governments and budget contingencies that stall strategic projects.

item.title: Lula diz que quer viver 120 anos para ver submarino nuclear pronto
item.description: President Lula (PT) visited the Aramar Nuclear Industrial Center and said he wants to live to 120 to see Brazil's nuclear-powered submarine completed. He pledged to secure funding to finish the nuclear propulsion project.

item.title: Como Donald Trump instrumentaliza a América Latina para sobreviver ao declínio imperial
item.description: Professor Jana Silverman analyzes Trump's offensive against Brazil and Latin America as an attempt to maintain declining hegemony. Trump uses trade threats and sanctions to suppress regional autonomy, particularly targeting Lula's government. Neofascism exploits resentment from workers who lost privileges under social neoliberalism.

item.title: As primeiras medidas do inquérito sobre filiação fraudulenta de Flávio ao Missão
item.description: The Federal Police opened an inquiry into the fraudulent affiliation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) to the Missão party. The PF requested access to TSE's FILIA system records and demanded clarifications from the party. The investigation, ordered by Minister Nunes Marques, will proceed at the Federal Regional Electoral Court of the Federal District.

item.title: ‘DeputadA’ e ‘senadorA’: candidatas cobram cargos no feminino no sistema de registro do TSE
item.description: Female candidates for the 2026 elections, led by Manuela d'Ávila (PSOL), denounced that the TSE's DivulgaCand system displayed their positions only in masculine forms ("senator", "deputy"). They filed a formal request with the TSE to use gender-appropriate titles matching their declared gender, arguing language reflects women's historical exclusion from politics. The mobilization rallied dozens of politicians across parties on social media.

item.title: Ex-ministro de Bolsonaro diz que PT atrasou Margem Equatorial
item.description: Former Minister Adolfo Sachsida accuses the Lula government of delaying Equatorial Margin oil exploration by four years, after Petrobras confirmed a discovery at the Morpho well off Amapá. Sachsida links the announcement to the 2026 campaign and endorses Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy to continue the project started in the previous administration.

item.title: Primeiras doações: Lula recebe R$ 500 e Grassi coloca R$ 290 mil na própria campanha
item.description: The TSE recorded the first donations for the 2026 presidential election. Lula (PT) declared R$ 500 from two individual donors, while Wilson Grassi (Democrata) self-funded R$ 290,000 across three personal contributions.
